subject: CloudWidgets technical demo — aligning SE, Eng, and procurement windows
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudwidgets.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jul 2024 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudWidgets technical demo — aligning SE, Eng, and procurement windows

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Per our conversation, we want to run a focused technical demo for CloudWidgets that includes: a Solutions Engineering deep-dive (60–75 minutes), time for your engineering team to ask integration/architecture questions, and a short procurement/checklist wrap-up (15 minutes).

Suggested slots (Pacific):
- Mon Jul 15 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Jul 16 — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Wed Jul 17 — 11:00–12:30 PT

Proposed attendees: Samantha (CloudWidgets CE), Alan Chu (CloudWidgets Eng), your procurement contact, our AE (Aditya Rao), our SE (Karthik Iyer), and one Redwood engineer (Mina Haddad) to take deep technical questions.

Prep items (attached): pre-demo-checklist.pdf — please send any network/IP allowlist info or SOC2/attestation requests ahead of time. If procurement needs a pricing or contract stub before the demo, flag that and we can route it.

Please indicate which slot works best for you or share up to two times using the Doodle link below and we will confirm availability on our side: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-cloudwidgets-demo

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Email: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudwidgets.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudwidgets.com>, IT Security <security@cloudwidgets.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jul 2024 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudWidgets technical demo — aligning SE, Eng, and procurement windows

Hi Tessa —

Thanks — appreciate the clear options. A few constraints from our side:
- Procurement needs a pricing summary and standard MSA template in advance; PO lead time is ~10 business days.
- Security is requesting SOC2 Type II evidence and a short questionnaire filled out (they asked for our vendor security questionnaire to be returned).
- Our Eng team (Alan) is generally available mornings PT. If possible, we prefer Mon Jul 15 09:00 PT or Wed Jul 17 11:00 PT.

I'll loop in procurement and security on this thread. Procurement (procurement@cloudwidgets.com) — if you need a formal calendar invite after Tessa confirms the slot, please advise on any contract gating we should prepare.

Also: could the SE tailor the demo to include an example around private deployment/networking constraints — specifically how Redwood handles VPC peering and KMS integrations? That will help security evaluate the requirements.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager, CloudWidgets
Samantha.Lee@cloudwidgets.com

Date: Tue, 09 Jul 2024 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudWidgets technical demo — aligning SE, Eng, and procurement windows

Hi Samantha / team —

Mon Jul 15 09:00 PT works for me (I'll block 90 minutes to allow for a short procurement wrap). Quick note on agenda — I suggest the following structure so your engineers get maximum signal:
1) 15 min — context and product priorities (AE / customer)
2) 30–40 min — SE demo: architecture patterns + live multi-tenant private deployment example
3) 20 min — deep dive on network/KMS/identity (Mina can take this)
4) 15 min — procurement/next steps

Per Samantha's ask: we will include VPC peering, KMS integration, and a short slide on our audit logs/data residency options. Mina, can you confirm you can cover the KMS/network piece if we land on Mon 7/15 09:00 PT?

Also: do you want us to bring a short pre-demo test run for any on-prem or air-gapped constraints? If security prefers, we can redact some demo data and prepare a sanitized walkthrough.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2024 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Mon Jul 15 09:00 PT — CloudWidgets demo + procurement sync

Thanks everyone — locking in Mon Jul 15, 09:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite sent to all participants.

Action items I will own before the demo:
- Share a one-page pricing summary and the standard MSA stub with procurement (attaching the pricing sheet + MSA link here).
- Send a DocuSign link for a mutual NDA / MPA acceptance if procurement requests it; procurement, please confirm preferred signatory and billing address.
- Karthik and Mina: please push the demo-agenda-v1.md to the shared folder; I'll include a short note on procurement expectations in the invite.

Procurement: procurement@cloudwidgets.com — if you can confirm the billing entity and PO cadence I will follow up with commercial terms and the DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-agenda-v1.md, redwood-security-pack.zip
